title: Walks that fail in the full sweep
goal: The scripted walks are the app driving itself, and some of them no longer reach what they were written to check. Find out what each failing walk is looking for, then either fix the app if the walk is right or update the walk if the app moved on. This serves the focus because the sweep is the only thing that tells a focus runner whether the change it just made broke anything: a sweep with failures nobody has named cannot say that, so every focus feature ships on a weaker claim than it should.

Each of these dropped a starter and then authored what it had dropped. Fixed the way the ten walks in that commit were: an action selectComponentOriginal after the drop, with a comment saying why. button-hug, clip-contents, layout-fits, out-of-view-mark, refused-width-says-why, size-limits, width-reads-back. container-too-small needed more: with two Cards in the layers list the Layout rows sit past the bottom and its rightClick on Body could not reach, so it deletes the copy and works on the original, leaving the document exactly the one card the walk is about.

copies-share-choice and copy-own-color were NOT that cause, despite sharing its shape. Both stop at a press of Related in Swatches because the colour picker never opens: a drop or an insert scrolls the dock down to the Library, which leaves the Fill well hard against the panel's top edge, and pressing it there opens nothing. Proven both ways in one walk: strip the reveals and the panel listing holds no picker control at all; put a reveal of the Component section in front of the same press and the same run lists Close (the picker), Save style, Shades, Related, Document, Recent. The walks now reveal first, which is what a person does; the swatch that opens nothing is filed as a-colour-swatch-at-the-very-top-of-the-panel-ope.

history-thumbnail-shapes was not an app fault and not a walk fault: six fixtures from a run that was KILLED on 2026-09-22 01:09 were still sitting in ~/Pictures/Screenshots, and lending refuses a name that is already taken. Fixed properly rather than by hand: Sources/Photonz/Playtest/PlaytestLentCaptures.swift writes every lend down as it happens, and PhotonzApp.init takes back whatever a killed run left before the capture shelf is built, exactly the way PlaytestFlagOverrides already recovers a feature left switched.
